cards.text: Judah's King Jehoram is dead, and the people of Jerusalem make his son Ahaziah king in his place. Not the oldest son, friend. The YOUNGEST.

cards.question: Why does Jehoram's youngest son Ahaziah end up king of Judah?

answers.text: Raiders had killed all the older sons
The older sons turned down the throne
The older sons were away at war

cards.text: Ahaziah is twenty-two when he becomes king, and he reigns in Jerusalem one year. I sat in a junk drawer LONGER than this man sat on a throne!
His mother is Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri, a king of Israel (1 Kings 16:23). And Ahaziah walks in the ways of the house of Ahab, Omri's son (1 Kings 16:28).

cards.question: Ahaziah walks in the ways of Ahab's house. Who is his counselor in wickedness?

cards.text: So Ahaziah does evil in the sight of the LORD, just like the house of Ahab. And after his father dies, Ahab's house becomes his counselors too.

cards.question: After his father dies, the house of Ahab counsels Ahaziah. Their counsel leads him to his ___.

cards.text: Ahaziah follows their counsel and goes to war with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel. They head out to fight at Ramoth-gilead.

cards.question: Ahaziah and Joram go to fight at Ramoth-gilead. Who's on the other side?
In the fight at Ramoth-gilead, the Arameans wound one of the kings. Which one?

cards.text: So the wounded Joram goes back to Jezreel to recover from his wounds.

cards.question: Joram is in Jezreel recovering from his wounds. What does Ahaziah king of Judah do?

answers.text: Goes down to Jezreel to visit him
Sends a letter wishing him well

cards.text: Sounds sweet, a king checking on his wounded ally. But this visit is where Ahaziah's downfall comes.

cards.question: Ahaziah's downfall came from ___ when he went to visit Joram.

cards.text: When Ahaziah arrives, he goes out with Joram to meet a man named Jehu son of Nimshi.

cards.question: Ahaziah and Joram go out to meet Jehu son of Nimshi. What had the LORD anointed Jehu to do?

cards.text: So Ahaziah walks out with Ahab's son to greet the man anointed to destroy Ahab's house. That's like waving hello to the tow truck that came for YOUR car!
Jehu is executing judgment on the house of Ahab. And he finds the rulers of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brothers, who are serving Ahaziah.

cards.question: Jehu finds the rulers of Judah and Ahaziah's nephews serving Ahaziah. What does Jehu do to them?

cards.text: Then Jehu goes looking for Ahaziah. And the king of Judah does EXACTLY what I'd do if a man with Jehu's job came looking for me.

cards.question: Jehu's soldiers capture Ahaziah. Where was Ahaziah hiding?

cards.text: Ahaziah is brought to Jehu and put to death. Then they bury him, and the reason is worth hearing.

cards.question: Ahaziah is put to death, but they still bury him. Why?

answers.text: His grandfather Jehoshaphat sought the LORD
He had been the king of Judah
His mother Athaliah asked them to

cards.question: After Ahaziah's death, someone from his house still has the strength to rule the kingdom.

findings.problem: This story card only repeats what cards 5 and 6 already told: Ahaziah goes out with Joram to meet Jehu, the man anointed to destroy Ahab's house. It adds a joke but does not move the passage forward. The joke should ride on a card that carries new passage content, such as card 8. Also, 'greet' turns the text's 'meet' into a friendly gesture the text does not describe.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: Four of the five choice cards are multiple choice (cards 2, 5, 9 and 10). There is one fill in the blank and no true or false, so multiple choice dominates the stop by a wide margin.
